reasoning_content:
The Maven build is in progress. The .m2 repository is growing (191M), so dependency downloads are being performed. The logs are buffered. Let's continue setting up infrastructure while the build runs in the background.

Let's start RabbitMQ (there's no systemd here, so we'll run it directly). We also need to set up the environment variables and configuration directories. Let's continue.

Let's start the RabbitMQ server in the background.

action.command:
hostname -I | awk '{print $1}' > /tmp/ip.txt; echo "ip=$(cat /tmp/ip.txt)"
# RabbitMQ needs a stable hostname mapping; add to /etc/hosts
HOST=$(hostname)
echo "127.0.0.1 $HOST" >> /etc/hosts
# Start RabbitMQ as root->rabbitmq user
export RABBITMQ_NODENAME=rabbit@localhost RABBITMQ_NODE_IP_ADDRESS=127.0.0.1 RABBITMQ_CTL_EPMD_ADDRESS=127.0.0.1
nohup rabbitmq-server > /tmp/rabbitmq.log 2>&1 &
echo "rabbitmq starting PID $!"
sleep 25
rabbitmqctl status 2>&1 | head -15 || tail -15 /tmp/rabbitmq.log
